findings.finding: Per-share values ignore existing dilutive securities. casefile fc.assumptions 'dilution' and spec.underwriting.opening_reconciliation use incremental_dilutive_shares 0 on 187,951,918 cover shares, while the 10-Q (ex_10q_20260902) shows Q1 FY2027 diluted weighted shares 194,378k vs basic 186,007k (about 8.4M treasury-method dilutive shares), 1.7M vested/exercisable options at a $2.34 strike (intrinsic $353.1M, about 0.9% of shares, not covered by the future-SBC charge), and management guides about 200M diluted shares for Q2 FY2027 (rp_g_shares_q2fy27, transcript). The rationale says convertibles/warrants status is 'missing' in dataqa. Every scenario value per share (bear 24.3, base 153-234, bull 638-963) is overstated by roughly 1-4% (vested options alone at least ~1%; up to ~4.5% if the full treasury-method gap is not covered by sbc_pct).
findings.where: companies/CRDO/out/casefile.json fc.assumptions[id=dilution], fc.spec.underwriting.opening_reconciliation.incremental_dilutive_shares; evidence_pack.json facts nm_shares_diluted_wavg_q_2026_08_01, guidance rp_g_shares_q2fy27
findings.fix: Add at least the 1.7M vested in-the-money options (net of the $2.34 strike) as incremental_dilutive_shares in the opening reconciliation, and state explicitly why unvested RSUs (diluted 194.4M vs basic 186.0M) are or are not covered by sbc_pct; rerun ticker-value.

findings.finding: The base case's current-year revenue (2,525.6M, +89%) rests on a FY2027 'more than 85%' statement found only in a third-party transcript copy (ex_tr_20260901, TradingKey). The source is registered with syndicated_from null although its publisher is 'TradingKey (copy of the issuer's call)', and with retrieval 'search_excerpt' although the page text is saved verbatim (gather/raw_reports/tradingkey_262145054.txt). Checked: the saved copy does say 'More than 85% YoY' and 'More than $600 million' optical (lines 73-74, 183-186), and 1.85 x FY2026 revenue 1,335,116,000 (companyfacts) = 2,469,964,600 matches rp_g_rev_fy27_floor. The written release ex_rel_20260901 does not restate it. Also used for growth_anchor, mature_margin, rp_g_shares_q2fy27, rp_g_ngopex_growth_fy27, rp_g_ngnetmargin_fy27.
findings.where: evidence_pack.json sources[id=ex_tr_20260901]; drivers.current_year_revenue; guidance rp_g_rev_fy27_floor, rp_g_growth_fy27_floor, rp_g_optical_fy27_floor
findings.fix: Set syndicated_from to the issuer's Q1 FY2027 earnings call of 2026-09-01 (issuer webcast/IR) and retrieval to the accurate value; show next to the result that the FY2027 floor is from a third-party copy of the call, not a written company document (or replace it with the issuer's own transcript/webcast if obtainable).

findings.finding: The audit record contradicts the executed valuation on claims: casefile assumption 'claims' says other_claims 0 with the rationale 'No preferred stock, minority interests or other senior claims ... recorded' and a falsifier 'A filing shows ... contingent consideration', while the executed scenarios carry other_claims 310,000,000 (DustPhotonics earn-out; 10-Q: 10.0M liability + 300.0M equity-classified, verified in the business-combination note). A reader of the assumption list sees a falsifier already triggered and a value that was not used.
findings.where: companies/CRDO/out/casefile.json fc.assumptions[id=claims] vs fc.spec scenarios other_claims (12 occurrences of 310000000.0)
findings.fix: Make the claims assumption row carry the 310M driver (evidence rp_dust_contingent / ex_10q_20260902) and its rationale (claim at filing fair value, shares not also added), or have the engine copy driver terminal.other_claims into that row; rerun.

findings.finding: The guidance track record is double counted: evidence_pack.guidance_track lists the same 7 quarters twice (once as 'Q@<date>', once as 'Q3 FY2025'...'Q1 FY2027'), so inputs.json guidance_track_record reports n 14, beats 14 for 7 real observations. The mean ratio (1.105) is unchanged, but the stated strength of the record is doubled. In addition, the Q@2026-01-31 entry uses guided_mid 340M (the 2025-12-01 guide, rp_rel_20251201) but cites nm_rel_20260209, the preliminary update that guided 404-408M before the report, so the cited source does not support the guided midpoint.
findings.where: evidence_pack.json guidance_track (period 'Q@2026-01-31' and the duplicated 'Q3 FY2025'..'Q1 FY2027' rows); companies/CRDO/inputs.json evidence_pack.guidance_track_record
findings.fix: Keep one row per quarter (n 7) and cite rp_rel_20251201 for the 340M Q3 FY2026 guide (state that a 404-408M pre-announcement existed on 2026-02-09); regenerate inputs with pack-to-inputs.

findings.finding: The engine's current_year_revenue basis string calls the FY2027 figure a 'company guidance midpoint 2,469,964,600 (2,469,964,600-2,469,964,600)' while it is a 'more than 85%' floor from a call; the analyst reason says so correctly, but the engine label (which travels into the casefile) mislabels a floor as a midpoint. The +55.7M track-record uplift uses the 7-quarter mean beat 1.105 although the last two beats were 1.016 and 1.019 (the reason acknowledges this).
findings.fix: Label the guidance row as a floor in the basis text; keep the uplift labelled as an analyst judgement, not as guidance.

findings.finding: Issuer releases registered as independent: rp_rel_20260413 and rp_rel_20251201 (Credo's own 8-K exhibits) have independent true, while the other issuer releases (nm_rel_*, ex_rel_20260901) are false.

Press and industry relays of a single management statement are registered as independent primary documents with syndicated_from null: fd_press_stocktwits_20261023 (relays the MaxLinear CEO on its 2026-10-22 call; the '20-30% share of 1.6T AEC' claim behind a bear scenario event, the base FY2028 growth reason and the MXL competitor row) and fd_ind_futurum_mrvl_20261009 (relays Marvell Investor Day). No raw copy of the Stocktwits page is saved, so the 20-30% figure cannot be checked locally; the MaxLinear release saved (gather/raw_field/mxl_8k_ex99_20261022.htm) mentions 1.6T-capable products but no share target.
findings.fix: Set syndicated_from to the MaxLinear Q3 2026 call (2026-10-22) and Marvell Investor Day (2026-10-06), independent false; keep the 20-30% target labelled as a relayed management claim (or save the page/transcript).

findings.finding: Unknown evidence ids remain in the pack: identity.type.history_rows[0..5].source_ids cite pf_cf_20220608, pf_cf_20230623, pf_cf_20240624, pf_cf_20250702, pf_cf_20260615, none of which is a registered source (the registered one is pf_history_companyfacts). The uncitable id_sec_submissions_20261028 (dated as_of) stays registered in sources, although it was removed from identity.evidence_ids.
findings.fix: Point the history rows at pf_history_companyfacts and leave id_sec_submissions_20261028 out of any citing field (or drop it).

findings.finding: Duplicate guidance items: ex_g_rev_q2fy27/ex_g_nggm_q2fy27/ex_g_gm_q2fy27/ex_g_ngopex_q2fy27/ex_g_opex_q2fy27 and rp_g_* carry the same Q2 FY2027 ranges from the same release (values verified against release_2026-09-01 line 33: revenue 525-535M, GAAP GM 62.9-64.9%, non-GAAP GM 67.0-69.0%, GAAP opex 199-204M). The earn-out share count used in the claims reason ('about 2.8-3.2M shares, from the 10-K note and the 2026-04-13 8-K as relayed by the lanes') is not checked against a saved document, and the run's gap text says 'up to ~3.21M shares / 310M' while 310M is the fair value, not a maximum.
findings.where: evidence_pack.json guidance (ex_g_* vs rp_g_*); drivers['terminal.other_claims'].reason; casefile gaps
findings.fix: Drop one set of duplicate guidance rows; state the earn-out maximum shares from the 10-K/8-K text with its id, and describe 310M as the filing fair value.

findings.finding: The 102.4M additional refundable capacity deposits (10-Q subsequent agreement, payable within FY2027; verified) are not in the opening bridge (bridge_events []); they are refundable through purchases, so the value effect is timing only (about 0.3% of market value).
findings.fix: Note it next to the result or add it as a bridge/working-capital timing item.
